items.title: Oracle Stock Could Be Software’s Next Big Winner
items.summary: Oracle’s spending and its debt pile are two major areas of concern that weighed down the shares.  The analysts, led by Brent Thill, are optimistic despite reducing their price target to $290 from $320 in a note earlier this week.  Despite the stock’s fall this year, Oracle’s fundamentals have not deteriorated, they noted.

items.title: Snowflake Q2 Earnings Beat on Product Revenues and AI Strength
items.summary: SNOW's Q2 earnings and revenues beat estimates as product revenues jump 37%, AI demand accelerates growth, and fiscal 2027 guidance moves higher.

items.title: Oracle To Face Earnings Test After Wild Year Riding AI Wave
items.summary: It was nearly 12 months ago that Oracle stock surged a record 36% on AI optimism. The company has had a rough run since then.

items.title: Microsoft, Amazon and 8 More Stocks Set to Win in a $26 Trillion AI Market
items.summary: Microsoft, Amazon and a raft of cloud-computing and software companies will be the AI winners, according to Jefferies analysts.

items.title: U.S. Debt, AI Boom Triggers Historic Borrowing Binge, Pushing Up Rates. What To Know.
items.summary: Surging U.S. debt and AI borrowing are pushing up Treasury yields, spurring an unusual bond market move by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
